parsed.name: Modbus RTU 从站串口工作器
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于管理与 Modbus RTU 主站设备之间的串口通信。它负责接收和组装 RTU 帧、校验 CRC、处理请求 PDU，并可将请求转发到 Modbus 服务端后返回响应，适合实验系统中的串口协议网关、仿真从站或通信桥接场景。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for managing serial communication with a Modbus RTU master device. It receives and assembles RTU frames, validates CRC, processes request PDUs, and can relay requests to a Modbus server before sending responses back. It is suitable for protocol gateways, simulated slaves, and communication bridging in laboratory systems.

actions.description: 处理收到的 Modbus 请求 PDU，并生成或转发对应响应。
actions.description_en: Process the received Modbus request PDU and generate or relay the corresponding response.

actions.description: 运行串口工作循环，接收并校验 Modbus RTU 帧，将请求转发处理后发送响应。
actions.description_en: Run the serial worker loop: receive and validate Modbus RTU frames, forward requests for processing, and send responses.
